subject: cpc
subject_name: Civil Procedure Code & Law of Limitation
summary: The Civil Procedure Code & Law of Limitation examination papers exhibit a consistent structural pattern, consistently dividing questions into Part A (short notes), Part B (long essays), and Part C (problem-based application questions). High-weightage topics such as Res Judicata, Pleadings, Limitation Act principles, and Appeals dominate the essay and problem sections, while procedural steps like jurisdiction, parties, and temporary injunctions recur frequently in Part A. Problem-based scenarios (Part C) heavily test procedural defaults, suits against the government, and limitation condonation issues.
